PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.PHASE_GATE: v2.5.0 local gate prepared for a Linux/macOS feedback release; hosted push CI and final tag release workflow remain required before publishing the release.
PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a release-candidate quality developer tool for Linux/macOS with feedback-driven MyGRACE ergonomics. v2.5.0 adds language-aware contract parsing and suggestions for Python and SQL, profile-aware verify/review modes for small projects, MODULE_ID validation for comma-separated mistakes, Python dependency diagnostics in doctor, and updated user-facing docs.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards; 76/76 contracted files, 368 function contracts, and 622 closed semantic blocks after v2.5.0 changes.
EVIDENCE.LOCAL_CI_GATE: scripts/ci.sh passed locally on 2026-05-20: cargo fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, runtime panic guard, 107 tests, release version guard, release freshness guard, release-candidate dry-run, release/install smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full --ci, refresh --json, and status --json.
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_VERSION_TRUTH: Cargo.toml and install.sh now target v2.5.0. scripts/release_freshness_guard.sh passes only if v2.5.0 is unpublished or points at HEAD; if a matching tag exists but does not point at HEAD, release work fails with a required version-bump message.
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: The installer still prefers signed-off release artifacts plus SHA256SUMS verification. Source fallback is now explicit: SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF for hosted fresh-install smoke, selected Git tag when available, and default main branch only during the pre-tag release-candidate window.
EVIDENCE.FRESH_INSTALL_TRUTH: Push CI fresh-install smoke uses raw.githubusercontent.com at the exact workflow commit plus SYN_INSTALL_SOURCE_REF, preventing a current-HEAD smoke job from silently installing an older release tag.
EVIDENCE.PACKAGE_TRUTH: The Cargo package is synapse-agent to avoid the crates.io syn parser conflict; the public binary and library crate remain syn.
EVIDENCE.MCP_CLI_TRUTH: syn mcp is public stdio-only. verify_project/review_code and syn verify/review now expose profile-aware strictness without changing the strict CI default.
EVIDENCE.NO_ACTIVE_PHASE_TRUTH: docs/plan-index.xml now has ACTIVE_PHASE none after all phase shards are done; status and refresh preserve that state instead of reporting a completed phase as active.
EVIDENCE.DOC_TRUTH: Public README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, WORKFLOW, and SUPPORT docs are guarded against ghost CLI commands, unsupported flags, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete release paths, unsupported Windows install claims, unmeasured token-savings percentages, and misleading privacy wording.
EVIDENCE.LICENSE_TRUTH: LICENSE now contains the full Apache License 2.0 text instead of a short placeholder.
EVIDENCE.SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: install.sh --diagnose reports independent OS and architecture support status, Linux/macOS artifact mapping, install directory status, tool availability, checksum verifier status, Windows packaging deferral, and SYN_INSTALL_DIR guidance.

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_V250_TAG_PENDING: The v2.5.0 public release is not complete until this commit is pushed, hosted GitHub CI passes, tag v2.5.0 is created at the verified commit, and the release workflow publishes Linux/macOS artifacts plus SHA256SUMS.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred and is not part of the first Linux/macOS public release scope.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE: Real user feedback still needs to be collected across more Linux/macOS environments after the public release.
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_TEST_FILE_SIZE_TARGET: tests/docs_parity.rs and tests/integration_test.rs exceed the 500-line Phase-2 maintainability target while remaining under the hard 1300-line gate.

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Push the v2.5.0 commit, wait for hosted Linux/macOS CI, then create the v2.5.0 tag at that commit and verify the release workflow before announcing the feedback release.
